clause_text: Notices under this Agreement shall be delivered by certified mail, return receipt requested, to the addresses set forth in Exhibit A.
Provider shall maintain 99.9% uptime for the patient portal storing Protected Health Information and will notify Client of any unplanned downtime within one (1) hour.
The mobile application will process credit card transactions and store cardholder data in accordance with the Provider's standard security measures.
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

The Provider shall process personal data of the Client's EU-based employees solely for the purpose of providing the Services and shall not transfer such data outside the European Economic Area without appropriate safeguards.

Provider shall maintain internal controls over financial reporting sufficient to support Client's Sarbanes-Oxley compliance obligations, including quarterly certification of financial statement accuracy.
Provider shall not offer, promise, or provide anything of value to any government official for the purpose of influencing an official act in connection with this Agreement.
Provider shall provide support during business hours (9am-5pm local time) and respond to Severity 1 incidents within four (4) hours.
